messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to publish TS major and a Py minor that contains a compatibility shim during today’s 15:00 PDT change window. Will run full canary smoke + signer checksum before promoting.

deploy-bot: publish pipeline queued by @maya at 2024-09-10T14:58:19Z — jobs: lint -> unit -> smoke-canary -> publish-dryrun

sam: quick ask: can we auto-dist-tag the old sync shim as 'legacy' so examples/docs keep working? otherwise a bunch of vendored shims will break immediately.

maya: yes planning: npm publish --tag canary for JS, then npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@version legacy; for Py we’ll upload a patch build to testpypi first and keep the legacy entrypoint name. share commands below.

rami: pre-publish checklist: (a) signer checksum validation (b) integration smoke against the canary project (c) open PR to examples to pin legacy shim (d) verify lockfile and bundled assets for path separators.

debra: add me as the escalation owner for rollback decisions. If the smoke fails or signer checksum mismatches we stop promotion and cut a rollback note. Also we must include a clear deprecation paragraph for the sync client in the release notes.

maya: commands I’ll run:
```
# JS
npm publish --tag canary --access public
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@1.0.0 legacy
npm dist-tag ls @redwood/sdk-js

# Py
poetry build
twine upload --repository testpypi dist/*
python tools/verify_signer.py --package redwood-sdk --checksum-file ci/signer_checksums.txt
python tools/smoke_canary.py --project redwood-canary
```

ci-bot: unit tests passed (all suites) — smoke-canary job started (smoke-runner-21)

ci-bot: smoke-runner-21 failed: bundler emitted path join error on Windows runners. Log: https://ci.internal/build/4512

rami: looking at logs — bundler path normalization broke on backslash inputs when building browser bundle. This is a packaging issue, not signer. I recommend blocking prod promotion until fixed.

maya: ack. aborting promotion. will rollback canary dist-tags and remove testpypi artifacts. postponing release to fix bundler path handling. requeue once patch landed.

deploy-bot: dist-tag rollback executed by @maya at 2024-09-10T15:08:02Z

sam: filing a quick PR to examples to pin package.json to legacy dist-tag so docs aren't broken in the meantime.

debra: drafting release note snippet: "Release postponed due to packaging incompatibility on Windows bundler. We will ship the TS major + Py patch when canary smoke is green. Sync client deprecation still planned — migration guidance included." Will attach migration example.

maya: migration example draft for notes:
```
// old compat import
import { RedwoodSync } from '@redwood/sdk-js/compat'

// new
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk-js'
const client = Redwood.init({compatMode: true})
```

rami: action list:
- fix path normalization in bundler (rami)
- update examples repo to pin legacy tag (sam)
- re-run canary smoke after patch (maya)
- finalize release notes + deprecation blurb (debra)

maya: I’ll re-run the publish-dryrun once bundler patch is merged; keeping the change window reserved but will not promote until signer and smoke pass. will post updates here.

ci-bot: smoke-runner-21 re-run started at 2024-09-10T15:16:40Z

ci-bot: smoke-runner-21 succeeded at 2024-09-10T15:22:00Z — all checks green

maya: promoting canary tags and publishing to registries now. tagging release branch and opening release-notes PR. will update when PR merges and dist-tags are live.

deploy-bot: publish pipeline completed by @maya at 2024-09-10T15:25:20Z — artifacts uploaded, dist-tags updated

debra: release notes PR opened and assigned. Targeting ship announcement at 17:00 PT. I included the deprecation timeline and migration snippet.

sam: thanks. follow-up: we should add a short note in the docs about how to pin to the legacy tag until customers migrate.

maya: will open an examples/docs PR to add the pin instructions and a short migration guide. closing thread when release PR is merged.

sam: :thumbsup:

maya: last update 2024-09-10T15:32:00Z — release PR merged, dist-tags live, examples pin PR opened (WIP).
